description: Every format of a design in its fitting file, in ONE zip: posts and banners as PNG, a moving story as MP4 (`motion`: WebM, GIF or Lottie), an A4 flyer as PDF. The link is for the signed-in person, valid one hour. Made in the person’s open editor (ask them to open its link first). Use it after create_campaign for «export all». Example: { design }. The design does not change.

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

motion.description: the file a moving board gets: mp4 (default), webm, gif, or lottie (a .json for the web and apps)

video.description: false: a moving story as a PNG too (default: MP4 when it moves)

name: export_campaign
title: Export the whole campaign
